products.name: FireRed & LeafGreen Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs, no code card. Charmander, the secret rare box topper, is not in the packs. TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: FireRed & LeafGreen Single Pack Blister
products.note: One FireRed & LeafGreen pack on a card (TCGplayer 488312). TCGplayer lists it without a market price, so it is priced at its pack.
